chat.attach.not_a_photo: {name} couldn't be read as a photo.
chat.cap.cost: {taf} stopped: this task would cost more than its limit for one task. Ask for something narrower, or someone who manages {taf} can raise the limit.
chat.cap.turns: {taf} stopped: this task took more steps than its limit for one task. Ask for something narrower.
chat.chats_were_not_exported_could: Your chats weren't exported: this {device} couldn't save the files.
chat.empty_named: Ask {taf} what it did, or tell it what to do differently. It stays inside its Card. A call it needs you to approve, from a chat or a scheduled run, shows here too.
chat.empty_unnamed: Ask it what it did, or tell it what to do differently. It stays inside its Card. A call it needs you to approve, from a chat or a scheduled run, shows here too.
chat.export_not_what_tafs_cloud: The export isn't what tafs cloud sends.
chat.failed.after: {taf} stopped part-way, after this went through: {calls}.
chat.failed.after_several: {taf} stopped part-way, after these went through: {calls}.

chat.file.attach_full.one: Attach: {count} file is the most a message carries
chat.file.attach_full.other: Attach: {count} files is the most a message carries

chat.file.no_app_opens: No app on this phone opens {name}.
chat.file.no_camera: There's no camera app on this phone to take a photo with.

chat.file.too_many.one: A message carries at most {count} files.
chat.file.too_many.other: A message carries at most {count} files.

chat.held: Waits until it's done, then goes as your next message
chat.jump_latest_something_new: Jump to the latest, something new
chat.message_carries_most_files: A message carries at most {per_message} files.
chat.not_on_cloud: This taf isn't running on tafs cloud, so it can't be messaged.
chat.send_once_files_up: Send once the files are up
chat.steer.coach_reads_next: Coach reads this at its next step
chat.steer.coach_reads_paused: Coach reads this when it carries on
chat.steer.it_reads_next: It reads this at its next step
chat.steer.it_reads_paused: It reads this when it carries on
chat.steer.not_read_before_end: It wasn't read before the work ended.

chat.steer.taf_reads_paused: {taf} reads this when it carries on
chat.stopped.declined: {taf} stopped: the AI declined to continue. Try asking another way.
chat.stopped.out_of_room: {taf} stopped: its reply ran out of room. Ask for something shorter, or for one part at a time.

chat.too_long.one: That's longer than {count} characters. Say it in fewer words.
chat.too_long.other: That's longer than {count} characters. Say it in fewer words.

chat.too_many: That's a lot of messages in a few minutes. Give {taf} a moment, then try again.
